lead.title: RougeTx emerges from stealth with a $58M Series A for its first drug against hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia
lead.deck: The Dutch biotech raises $58M (€52M), co-led by BioGeneration Ventures, Angelini Ventures and Kurma Partners, with the EIB via Angelini's Aurea vehicle. The funds take RTX-001, a small molecule that helps pericytes attach to blood vessels and stabilise them, towards first-in-human trials in HHT, a hereditary bleeding disorder with no approved therapy.

milestone.title: Genmab and AbbVie: epcoritamab added to R-CHOP cuts the risk of progression or death by 51% in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
milestone.summary: In EPCORE DLBCL-2 (about 900 patients randomised 2:1, subcutaneous CD20×CD3 bispecific as a fixed course), the primary progression-free survival endpoint reaches an HR of 0.49 in IPI 3-5 patients, and the same HR in the overall population. Absolute rates, overall survival and detailed tolerability are not yet disclosed; Genmab shares rise about 8% in Copenhagen.
milestone.why: A bispecific could become the frontline standard in DLBCL, repricing the whole CD20×CD3 field and its competitors (Polivy, tafasitamab) and feeding the debate on the value of European antibody platforms.

deal.thesis: Oxford Science Enterprises leads this $47M package (OTB Ventures and In-Q-Tel come in, Y Combinator and BlueYard follow), topped up by up to $20M of non-dilutive Slovak and EU funding. Sensible makes mRNA inside engineered living cells instead of by in vitro transcription: lower production cost and less immunogenicity for therapies needing high or repeated doses.

brefsEurope.title: Rivercell raises $25M seed led by HV Capital to build an AI "virtual cell"
brefsEurope.summary: HCVC, Alven and Bpifrance Digital Venture participate; the automated platform generates time-resolved single-cell data after treatment to train a predictive model. Founded by Yann Fleureau (co-founder of Cardiologs, acquired by Philips) and Eric Durand (ex-Novartis, Owkin, Bioptimus).

brefsEurope.title: Argenx halts its Phase 3 UNITY trial of efgartigimod in Sjögren's for futility; shares fall about 18%
brefsEurope.summary: An independent committee judged the primary endpoint (systemic disease activity at 48 weeks) could not be met, with no new safety signal. The same day, FB102 (from Forte Biosciences) met its primary endpoint in a 126-patient Phase 2 celiac disease trial and will move to Phase 3.

brefsEurope.title: ADC Therapeutics secures an $86.6M private placement, with Bain Capital Life Sciences as new investor, and restructures its debt
brefsEurope.summary: Redmile, TCGX and Nantahala follow; the senior loan is cut to $50M and the $150M payment to HealthCare Royalty on a change of control is removed. The cash backs Zynlonta Phase 3 studies, while the FDA raised benefit-risk concerns on LOTIS-5 in August.

brefsIntl.title: Roche partners with Defand on molecular glue degraders, in a deal reportedly worth close to $1B in total
brefsIntl.summary: Research and licensing agreement with an option to expand to more targets; the financial terms come only from Endpoints News (anonymous source, upfront reportedly under $10M). A comparable for the value of early-stage molecular glue platforms.

brefsIntl.title: Viatris to acquire Pacira for $1.65B ($36.50 per share, 45% premium) for two non-opioid pain drugs
brefsIntl.summary: Exparel and Zilretta had combined 2025 sales of $692M; closing expected by the end of 2026. A multiple comparable for non-opioid analgesics, not an entry opportunity.

word.fr: Molecular glue that triggers protein degradation
word.definition: A small molecule that glues a disease protein to the cell's cleaning machinery, which then destroys it instead of merely blocking it.

parts.label: Target protein
parts.role: the target: the disease protein to eliminate

parts.label: E3 ligase
parts.role: the recycler: the enzyme that tags proteins for destruction

parts.label: Glue small molecule
parts.role: the glue: brings target and ligase together though they have no natural link

how.t: The molecule binds the E3 ligase and creates a surface that recognises the target protein.
The ligase attaches ubiquitin tags to the target.
The proteasome destroys the tagged protein; the molecule can start over.

word.why: VC angle: it opens targets once thought undruggable with small oral molecules; pharma deals run to billions in milestones, but clinical data remain scarce, hence the interest in watching discovery platforms before their first readout.

startups.name: Neomorph
startups.use: Molecular glue pioneer; $100M Series B led by Deerfield in April 2026, funding the Phase 1/2 trial of NEO-811 (oral ARNT degrader) in clear cell renal cell carcinoma.

startups.name: Monte Rosa Therapeutics
startups.use: Nasdaq-listed (GLUE) with three clinical programs (MRT-6160, MRT-8102, MRT-2359) and a Roche collaboration ($50M upfront in 2023).

startups.name: Proxygen
startups.use: CeMM spin-off in Vienna; collaboration with Merck KGaA worth up to €495M (2022) and a licensing deal with Merck & Co. (2023).

startups.name: Defand Therapeutics
startups.use: Molecular glue screening platform; research and licensing agreement with Roche announced on October 8, 2026.
